Expressive ivory eyes and a tiny copper seed charm. Full body visible, fixed slightly elevated three-quarter 2D view, facing a little right; both feet readable. Style: original ink-outline paper-puppet wasteland fable, chibi proportions, bold dark contour, restrained hand-drawn hatching, matte flat layered illustration rather than rendered 3D, five large muted color groups, compact clean silhouette readable at 64px. True transparent alpha background, opaque character body, no floor, no cast background shadow. Square 1024x1024 composition, character fills about 85% of the canvas height without cropping. No text, no logos, no border, no watermark. Do not imitate any existing game's characters, costume or composition; do not reuse the previous bio-farm artwork. Keep limb articulation visually distinct so a later hand-authored cutout rig can be designed; this image itself is not an animation or rig.
